subject: Quickcart hosted API sandbox trial: coordinate live eval & preflight
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex@quickcart.io>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quickcart hosted API sandbox trial — looking to book a live eval

Hi Irene,

We just signed up for the hosted API sandbox (Quickcart account: quickcart-prod). We'd like to book a short live evaluation to validate latency, token pricing, and a quick integration sanity check with our sample payloads.

Our engineering lead and ops person will join: Alex Johnson (me) and ops@quickcart.io. We're in PDT (San Francisco). Are there any 30–45 minute windows tomorrow or Thursday afternoon? Preferrable start between 10:00–16:00 PT.

Also helpful if you can enable a temporary sandbox API key or outline the preflight steps so our engineers can bring a small sample (I'll attach a sample payload).

Thanks — excited to move quickly.
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Integrations, Quickcart
ops@quickcart.io
[attachment: Quickcart_Sample_Payload.json]

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Alex Johnson <alex@quickcart.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quickcart hosted API sandbox trial — looking to book a live eval

Hi Alex — great to meet you (virtually).

Thanks for the context. We can do either a 30- or 45-minute technical walkthrough; for the integration checks you described I recommend 45 minutes so Ben (our PLG engineer) can join and do a small live prompt run with your payload.

Available windows (PT):
- Wed 2028-06-06 10:30–11:15 (45m)
- Wed 2028-06-06 14:00–14:45 (45m)
- Thu 2028-06-07 11:00–11:45 (45m)

If one of those works I will send a calendar invite. Please share any additional sample prompts or notes — I see the JSON you attached, thank you.

Preflight checklist (short):
- Confirm timezone and attendees
- Share any rate-limited endpoints or proprietary prompts you want to test
- We will provision a temporary sandbox API key for the session (expires in 24h)

I'll also loop in Sean from CS to provision any longer-lived sandbox access if you want a persistent test key after the eval.

Best,
Irene Choi
SDR, Redwood Inference
[redwood-invite: https://redwood.app/scheduler/slot/abc123]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.com; Alex Johnson <alex@quickcart.io>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quickcart hosted API sandbox trial — looking to book a live eval

Thanks for looping me in — I can take the 45-minute slot on Wed 14:00 PT if that works for you.

Quick note for Alex: if you can paste a representative user prompt and the desired output shape into the meeting notes ahead of time that will save us 10–15 minutes. I will prepare an eval template and bring a short checklist (attached as redwood_eval_prep.pdf).

– Ben
Ben Carter
PLG Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment referenced: redwood_eval_prep.pdf]

From: Alex Johnson <alex@quickcart.io>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com; ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quickcart hosted API sandbox trial — looking to book a live eval

Hi Irene / Ben — Wed 14:00 PT works great. Can we make it 45 minutes as you suggested. I've updated our calendar and invited ops@quickcart.io and our engineering lead Sam.

I pasted a short representative prompt below and attached the sample payload JSON.

Representative prompt:
"Given an order payload, produce a compact fulfillment-summary with SKU counts and a boolean flag if any items require cold-chain handling."

Thanks — see you Wednesday.
Alex
[attachment: Quickcart_Sample_Payload.json]

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quickcart hosted API sandbox trial — provisioning request + calendar invite

Sean — forwarding the confirmed Quickcart eval (Wed 2028-06-06 14:00 PT, 45m). They need a temporary sandbox API key for the live run and possibly a persistent test key after the session. Quick details:
- Account: Quickcart (deal QC-2028-1137)
- HubSpot record: HSP-489221
- Attachments: Quickcart_Sample_Payload.json (sample prompt included)
- Calendar invite: https://redwood.app/scheduler/slot/abc123

Can you provision a one-time sandbox key that expires in 24 hours and a separate persistent test key with rate limits appropriate for a small proof-of-concept (cc Ben to discuss limits)? If you need any contract/terms sign-off before persistent access, flag it and we'll escalate.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Irene Choi
SDR, Redwood Inference
notes: Follow-up action: Sean to create temporary key and comment on HubSpot record HSP-489221.
Internal: Ben to prepare short checklist and bring an example run using Quickcart_Sample_Payload.json.
